zones.name: Rear Panel
zones.description: Before: ground rod, rear panel, ID plates, DCS, convenience receptacle, flexible sleeve, fuel fill, rear door

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect ground rod and cable for missing parts, damaged, or loose connection (WP 0002, Equipment Description and Data, Front Panel, and WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions, Installation of Ground Rod). 2. Notify field maintenance of corroded parts.
steps.noGoCondition: Ground rod, clamp, or cable missing, damaged, or connection loose.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect rear panel for damage or corroded parts. 2. Notify field maintenance of minor corrosion or damage.
steps.noGoCondition: Rear panel missing or punctured.

steps.procedure: 1. Ensure ID plates are present, secure, and legible. Three are required (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions, Decals and Instructions Plates). 2. Notify field maintenance of missing, loose, or illegible plates.

1. Check cover, hinges, seals, and latch for damage or loose or corroded parts. 2. Secure cover in open position. 3. Notify field maintenance of damage, loose or corroded parts, or cover that cannot be secured.
1. Inspect for damaged, loose, and missing parts. 2. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Damaged, loose, or missing parts.

steps.procedure: 1. Check cover and hinge for damage or loose or corroded parts. 2. Check receptacles for damage or corroded parts. 3. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Cover will not close. Receptacles damaged or corroded.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect for tears, loose closure, or separation from rear panel. 2. Tighten loose ties. 3. Notify field maintenance of tears.
steps.noGoCondition: Separated from rear panel.

steps.procedure: 1. Clean fuel fill (Figure 1, Item 1) area of dirt and debris (WP 0016, Service Fuel System). 2. Inspect the auxiliary fuel connections for damaged, corroded, or missing parts. 3. Inspect cap and strainer for dirt, wear, and defects. 4. Remove dirt on cap or strainer. 5. Inspect chain and gasket for wear. 6. Notify field maintenance of wear. 7. Inspect grounding stud (fuel fill static ground) for damage or corrosion. 8. Notify field maintenance of minor damage to grounding stud (fuel fill static ground).
steps.noGoCondition: Damaged, corroded, or missing parts. Damaged or missing cap, punctured or missing strainer. Damaged or missing gasket. Grounding stud (fuel fill static ground) missing or corroded.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect door, hinges, seals, and latch for damage or loose or corroded parts. 2. Notify field maintenance of damage or loose or corroded parts.
steps.noGoCondition: Door cannot be secured.

zones.name: Inside Rear Door
zones.description: Before: fuel tank, fuel system hoses, fuel pumps and manifold, electrical connections

steps.procedure: 1. Open rear door. 2. Check level: by sight and by energizing DCS (Figure 1, Item 2) (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions) and viewing displayed fuel level. 3. Inspect fuel tank (Figure 1, Items 6) for leaks, damage, and loose or missing parts. 4. Notify field maintenance of defect.
steps.noGoCondition: Fuel level is less than 4%. Any classification of fuel leak or damage, or any loose or missing parts.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect for leaks and damaged, loose, or missing hardware. 2. Notify field maintenance of defect.
steps.noGoCondition: Any classification of fuel leak or damaged, loose, or missing parts.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect fuel pumps and fuel manifold (Figure 1, Item 5) for leaks or damage. 2. Notify field maintenance of defect.
steps.noGoCondition: Any classification of fuel leak or damage.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect (visually only) electrical connectors at relay panel and electrical connections for looseness. 2. Push loose connectors into place. 3. Notify field maintenance of defect. 4. Close rear door.
steps.noGoCondition: Connector looseness cannot be resolved.

zones.name: Top Panel
zones.description: Before: top panel, grates, ID plate, radiator exterior and interior, muffler

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect top panel for damage or corroded parts. 2. Notify field maintenance of minor corrosion or damage. 3. Inspect air intake and exhaust grates for debris. 4. Remove debris from intake and exhaust grates if present. 5. Notify field maintenance of defect.
steps.noGoCondition: Top panel missing or punctured. Clogged intake and/or exhaust grates cannot be resolved.

steps.procedure: 1. Ensure ID plate is present, secure, and legible. One is required (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions). 2. Notify field maintenance of missing, loose, or illegible plates.
1. Inspect for leaks. 2. Notify field maintenance for corrosion and Class I, II, or III leaks.
steps.noGoCondition: Any Class III coolant leaks.

steps.procedure: 1. Energize DCS (Figure 1, Item 2) screen (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions). 2. Check coolant temperature on DCS (Figure 1, Item 2) (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions). WARNING: Do not remove the radiator cap if the DCS (Figure 1, Item 2) is showing a temperature of 100°F or higher. 3. Remove radiator cap and ensure coolant is visible. 4. Inspect coolant color for contamination. 5. Inspect coolant level and add through overfill bottle as required (WP 0015, Service Cooling System). 6. Notify field maintenance for corrosion and Class I, II, or III leaks.
steps.noGoCondition: Milky or dirty color.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect muffler for damage, punctures, or corrosion. 2. Inspect muffler for obstruction. 3. Verify there are no obstructions to exhaust. 4. Inspect muffler rain cap for proper operation, damage, or corrosion. 5. Notify field maintenance of minor corrosion or damage to any part of muffler.
steps.noGoCondition: Muffler punctured, damaged, or corroded through to interior. Obstructions present. Rain cap missing or inoperable.

zones.name: Right-Side Panel
zones.description: Before: right-side panel, ID plates, skid base, oil drain outlet, output box door, right-side door

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect right-side panel for damage or corroded parts. 2. Notify field maintenance of minor corrosion or damage.
steps.noGoCondition: Right-side panel missing or punctured.

steps.procedure: 1. Ensure ID plates are present, secure, and legible. Six are required (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions). 2. Notify field maintenance of missing, loose, or illegible plates.
1. Inspect skid base for cracks, dents, and corrosion. 2. Inspect lifting ring for bent, broken, or missing pin. 3. Notify field maintenance of minor corrosion or damage.
steps.noGoCondition: Skid base cracked or shows signs of structural damage. If lifting ring shows signs of corrosion, bending, broken, or missing pin.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect oil drain outlet (Figure 2, Item 4) for leaks. 2. Notify field maintenance of Class I, II, or III leaks. 3. Notify field maintenance of missing, loose, or cracked oil drain outlet (Figure 2, Item 4) cap.
steps.noGoCondition: Class III leak.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect door, hinges, seals, and latch for damage; loose or corroded parts. 2. Notify field maintenance of damage; loose or corroded parts.
steps.noGoCondition: Door cannot be secured.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect door, hinges, seals, and latch for damage; loose or corroded parts. 2. Notify field maintenance of damage; loose or corroded parts.
steps.noGoCondition: Door cannot be secured.

zones.name: Inside Output Box Door
zones.description: Before: output connections, terminal board cover, ID plates, terminal nut wrench

steps.procedure: 1. Open output box door (Figure 2, Item 5). 2. Inspect output box door (Figure 2, Item 5). 3. Open output terminal board cover. 4. Inspect ground and load cable connections and retaining clips for tightness to output load board by pulling gently. 5. Tighten as required (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions). 6. Inspect terminals, terminal nuts, and retaining clips for damage or corrosion. 7. Notify field maintenance of damage or corrosion to terminals, retaining clips or terminal nuts.
steps.noGoCondition: Door cracked, missing, hinges missing or not working properly. Ground and load cable connections are loose. Ground or load cable cannot be secured. Terminals, terminal nuts, damaged, missing, or corroded.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect output terminal board protective cover for cracks, corroded, damaged hinge, and/or damaged hinge fasteners. 2. Notify field maintenance of corroded hinge or minor damage. 3. Close output terminal board cover.
steps.noGoCondition: Output terminal board protective cover missing, damaged or punctured. Missing or damaged hinge or hinge fasteners.

steps.procedure: 1. Ensure ID plates are present, secure, and legible. Two are required (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions). 2. Notify field maintenance of missing, loose, or illegible plates.

1. Inspect terminal nut wrench and rope for damage. 2. Ensure terminal nut wrench is secured properly to rope. 3. Notify field maintenance of damage or missing terminal nut wrench. 4. Close output box door (Figure 2, Item 5).

zones.name: Inside Right-Side Door
zones.description: Before: engine compartment, exhaust pipe, radiator hoses, winterization kit, oil, fuel, air cleaner, AC generator, storage box

steps.procedure: 1. Open right-side door. 2. Inspect for leaks. 3. Notify field maintenance of any Class I, II, or III oil or coolant leaks.
steps.noGoCondition: Any classification of fuel, Class III oil, or coolant leaks.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect internal exhaust pipe (Figure 2, Item 1) for damage, corrosion, or puncture. 2. Inspect exhaust pipe clamps for looseness or corrosion. 3. Notify field maintenance of loose or missing clamp(s).
steps.noGoCondition: Any puncture to exhaust pipe. Missing clamp or separated exhaust joint.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect radiator hoses and pipes (Figure 2, Item 2) and clamps for leaks, looseness, damage, corrosion, or puncture. 2. Notify field maintenance of any Class I, II, or III coolant leaks.
steps.noGoCondition: Class III coolant leak, missing clamp, or puncture of hoses or pipes.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect winterization kit heater body for leaks. 2. Inspect winterization kit fuel pump and lines for leaks or missing or damaged clamps. 3. Inspect coolant hoses and clamps for leaks, looseness, damage, corrosion, or puncture. 4. Notify field maintenance of any Class I, II, or III coolant leaks.
steps.noGoCondition: Any classification of fuel leak or Class III coolant leak. Any fuel leak or missing clamp. Class III coolant leak, missing clamp, or punctured of hoses.

steps.procedure: NOTE: Oil drain line is located at the oil drain assembly at the bottom of the oil pan. 1. Inspect oil drain line for leaks. 2. Notify field maintenance of Class I, II, or III oil leaks. 3. Ensure oil drain line ball valve is in off position. 4. Notify field maintenance of defect.
steps.noGoCondition: Class III oil leak.

steps.procedure: 1. Check oil level (WP 0017, Service Engine Oil). 2. Add oil as required (WP 0017, Service Engine Oil). 3. Ensure oil fill cap is tightened securely. 4. Notify field maintenance of defect.
steps.noGoCondition: Oil fill cap missing.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect fuel lines and fittings for leaks or corrosion. 2. Notify field maintenance of corroded fittings.
steps.noGoCondition: Any fuel leak.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect fuel filter/water separator for leaks, damage, or loose fittings (WP 0016, Service Fuel System). 2. Notify field maintenance of loose fittings or damage. 3. Inspect fuel filter/water separator bowl for water or contaminants (WP 0016, Service Fuel System). 4. Drain water and contaminants from fuel filter/water separator if present (WP 0016, Service Fuel System). 5. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Any fuel leak.

steps.procedure: 1. Check air cleaner assembly (Figure 4, Item 2) for damage or restriction (WP 0014, Service Air Cleaner). 2. Open dust ejection valve and remove dust and particles (WP 0014, Service Air Cleaner). 3. Remove or inspect air cleaner element for damage or restriction, replace as required. 4. Notify field maintenance of minor damage to assembly.
steps.noGoCondition: Damage that restricts air flow, restriction indicator showing red band.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect AC generator (Figure 2, Item 3) for cracks, breaks, and loose or missing hardware or wiring. 2. Inspect AC generator (Figure 2, Item 3) wiring for corrosion, breaks, and loose or missing wiring. 3. Notify field maintenance of corrosion.
steps.noGoCondition: Cracked generator housing, broken, or missing hardware. Loose, broken, or missing wiring.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect storage box for damage, missing or loose hardware, or missing contents. 2. Notify field maintenance of defect. 3. Close right-side door.

zones.name: Front Panel
zones.description: Before: front panel, ID plate, NATO slave receptacle, grounding rod storage door

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect front panel for damage or corroded parts. 2. Inspect access panel for damage, corrosion, or loose fit. 3. Notify field maintenance of minor corrosion, damage, or loose access panel.
steps.noGoCondition: Front panel missing or punctured. Access panel missing.

steps.procedure: 1. Ensure ID plate is present, secure, and legible. One is required (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions). 2. Notify field maintenance of missing, loose, or illegible plate.
1. Inspect for missing safety cap. 2. Inspect damaged, loose, or corroded connections. 3. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Safety cap missing. Damaged, loose, or corroded connections.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect grounding rod storage door (Figure 3, Item 2) for damage or corrosion. 2. Notify field maintenance of damage or corrosion.

zones.name: Left-Side Panel
zones.description: Before: left-side panel, fuel drain fitting, skid base, left-side door

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect left-side panel for damage or corroded parts. 2. Notify field maintenance of minor corrosion or damage. 3. Inspect air intake grate for debris. 4. Remove debris from intake grate if present. 5. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Left-side panel missing or punctured. Clogged intake grate cannot be resolved.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect fuel drain for leaks, missing cap, or damage. 2. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Any fuel leak or missing cap.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect skid base for cracks, dents, and corrosion. 2. Inspect lifting ring for corrosion, bending, broken, or missing pin. 3. Notify field maintenance of minor corrosion or damage.
steps.noGoCondition: Skid base cracked, dented, or shows signs of structural damage. Lifting ring corroded, bent, broken, or missing pin.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect door, hinges, seals, and latch for damage; loose or corroded parts. 2. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Door cannot be secured.

zones.name: Inside Left-Side Door
zones.description: Before: oil filter, engine compartment, coolant overflow bottle, alternator, batteries, starter, AC generator, radiator hoses, document box

steps.procedure: 1. Open left-side door. 2. Inspect oil filter (Figure 4, Item 6) for leaks. 3. Notify field maintenance of Class I, II, or III oil leaks. 4. Check oil filter (Figure 4, Item 6) for dents, cracks or damage. 5. Check oil filter (Figure 4, Item 6) for tightness manually. 6. Turn hand tight if loose. 7. Notify field maintenance if oil filter (Figure 4, Item 6) can be turned by hand.
steps.noGoCondition: Class III oil leak. Oil filter cannot be tightened by hand.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect for leaks 2. Notify field maintenance of any Class I, II, or III oil or coolant leaks.
steps.noGoCondition: Any classification of fuel leak. Class III oil or coolant leaks.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect for leaks, cracks, loose hoses, or missing cap. 2. Connect loose hoses. 3. Check coolant level (WP 0015, Service Cooling System). 4. Fill cooling system as required (WP 0015, Service Cooling System). 5. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Class III coolant leak. Missing cap. Hose cannot be reconnected.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect for loose wires or cracked housing. 2. Verify presence of belt. 3. Notify field maintenance for loose wires, cracked housing, or frayed, cracked, or loose belt.
steps.noGoCondition: Loose wires or cracked housing. Belt missing, loose, frayed, or cracked.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect batteries (Figure 4, Item 5) and cables for cracked or swollen casings, corroded terminals, loose connections, or missing plastic terminal covers. 2. Notify field maintenance of corroded terminals, loose connections, or missing plastic terminal covers.
steps.noGoCondition: Cracked or swollen casing, corroded terminals, or detached cables.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect starter (Figure 4, Item 4) for damage, corrosion, or loose wiring. 2. Notify field maintenance if corroded, damaged or loose wires are found. 3. Inspect NATO slave receptacle (Figure 3, Item 1) terminals and wires for loose connections, signs of arcing, corrosion, or other damage. 4. Notify field maintenance of damage, corrosion, loose connections, and signs of arcing, or other damage.
steps.noGoCondition: NATO slave receptacle (Figure 3, Item 1) terminal and wires loose, damaged, corroded, signs of arcing or other damage.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect AC generator (Figure 2, Item 3) and wiring for cracks, breaks, and loose or missing hardware or wiring. 2. Notify field maintenance of corrosion.
steps.noGoCondition: Cracked generator housing, or broken, loose, or missing hardware or wiring.

steps.procedure: 1. Ensure ID plates are present, secure, and legible. Two are required (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions). 2. Notify field maintenance of missing, loose, or illegible plate.
1. Inspect radiator hoses and pipes (Figure 4, Item 3) and clamps for leaks, looseness, damage, corrosion, or punctures. 2. Notify field maintenance of any Class I, II, or III coolant leaks.
steps.noGoCondition: Class III coolant leak, missing clamp, or puncture of hoses or pipes.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect document box for damage, missing or loose hardware, or missing contents. 2. Notify field maintenance of defects. 3. Close left-side door. 4. Start generator set (WP 005, Operation During Usual Conditions)

zones.name: During: Rear Panel and Inside Rear Door
zones.description: During operation: DCS, engine, ground rod, rear door, convenience receptacle, fuel system, electrical connections

steps.zone: During: Rear Panel and Inside Rear Door
steps.procedure: 1. Inspect indicators for proper operation, erratic display, obvious improper reporting (example: unit overheated, coolant temperature indicates 150°F (65.5°C). 2. Check battery voltage on DCS (Figure 1, Item 2) operator’s main screen (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions). 3. Ensure circuit interrupter is closed as required. 4. Close as required. 5. Notify field maintenance of defect.
steps.noGoCondition: Indicators not operating properly. Battery voltage is below 16 VDC. Circuit interrupter will not remain closed.

steps.zone: During: Rear Panel and Inside Rear Door
steps.procedure: 1. Check color of exhaust smoke. 2. Listen for any unusual engine noises. 3. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Exhaust smoke is black, white, or blue. Unusual, severe engine noises.

steps.zone: During: Rear Panel and Inside Rear Door
steps.procedure: 1. Inspect visually for arcing, damage, corrosion, and loose connections. 2. Notify field maintenance of corroded parts.
steps.noGoCondition: Arcing, damage, corrosion, or loose connections.

steps.zone: During: Rear Panel and Inside Rear Door
steps.procedure: 1. Inspect door, hinges, seals, and latch for damage; loose or corroded parts. 2. Notify field maintenance of damage; loose or corroded parts.
steps.noGoCondition: Door cannot be secured.

steps.zone: During: Rear Panel and Inside Rear Door
steps.procedure: 1. Reset GFCI circuit breaker (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions). 2. Notify field maintenance if GFCI circuit breaker will not reset.

steps.zone: During: Rear Panel and Inside Rear Door
steps.procedure: 1. Open rear door. 2. Inspect fuel tank (Figure 1, Item 6) for leaks, damage, and loose or missing parts. 3. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Any classification of fuel leak, damage, or any loose or missing parts.

steps.zone: During: Rear Panel and Inside Rear Door
steps.procedure: 1. Inspect fuel system hoses for leaks and damaged, loose, or missing hardware. 2. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Any classification of fuel leak or damaged, loose, or missing parts.

steps.zone: During: Rear Panel and Inside Rear Door
steps.procedure: 1. Inspect fuel pumps and fuel manifold (Figure 1, Item 5) for leaks or damage. 2. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Any classification of fuel leak or damage.

steps.zone: During: Rear Panel and Inside Rear Door
steps.procedure: 1. Inspect (visually only) electrical connectors at relay panel and electrical connections for looseness. 2. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Connector loose.

steps.zone: During: Rear Panel and Inside Rear Door
steps.procedure: 1. Inspect (visually only) relay panel cover and electrical connections for damage. 2. Notify field maintenance of minor damage. 3. Close rear door.
steps.noGoCondition: Relay panel cover punctured.

zones.name: During: Inside Right-Side Door
zones.description: During operation: engine compartment, oil drain line, fuel lines, oil level, AC generator

steps.procedure: 1. Open right-side door. 2. Inspect for leaks. 3. Notify field maintenance of any Class I, II, or III oil or coolant leaks.
steps.noGoCondition: Any classification of fuel leak. Class III oil or coolant leaks.

steps.procedure: NOTE: Oil drain line is located at the oil drain assembly at the bottom of the oil pan. 1. Inspect oil drain line for leaks. 2. Notify field maintenance of Class I, II, or III oil leaks.
steps.noGoCondition: Class III oil leak.

steps.itemDescription: Fuel Lines and Fuel Filter/Water Separator
steps.procedure: 1. Inspect fuel lines, fittings, and fuel filter/water separator for leaks or corrosion. 2. Notify field maintenance of defect.
steps.noGoCondition: Any fuel leak.

steps.procedure: 1. Check oil level (WP 0017, Service Engine Oil). 2. Add oil as required (WP 0017, Service Engine Oil). 3. Ensure oil fill cap is tightened securely. 4. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Oil fill cap missing.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect for excessive noise and vibration. 2. Inspect for external damage, arcing, and loose connections. 3. Notify field maintenance of defects. 4. Close right-side door.
steps.noGoCondition: Excessive noise and/or vibration. Signs of damage, arcing, or loose connections.

zones.name: During: Left-Side Panel and Inside Left-Side Door
zones.description: During operation: fuel drain, cooling fan, engine compartment, coolant overflow bottle, AC generator

steps.zone: During: Left-Side Panel and Inside Left-Side Door
steps.procedure: 1. Inspect fuel drain for leaks, missing cap, or damage. 2. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Any classification of fuel leak or missing cap.

steps.zone: During: Left-Side Panel and Inside Left-Side Door
steps.procedure: NOTE: Observe fan operation through grate on left-side panel. 1. Inspect visually for obstruction, damage, and looseness. 2. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Damaged or loose fan.

steps.zone: During: Left-Side Panel and Inside Left-Side Door
steps.procedure: 1. Open left-side door. 2. Inspect for leaks. 3. Notify field maintenance of any Class I, II, or III oil or coolant leaks.
steps.noGoCondition: Any classification of fuel leak. Class III oil or coolant leaks.

steps.zone: During: Left-Side Panel and Inside Left-Side Door
steps.procedure: 1. Inspect for leaks or loose hoses. 2. Check coolant level (WP 0015, Service Cooling System). 3. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Class III coolant leak or missing cap.

steps.zone: During: Left-Side Panel and Inside Left-Side Door
steps.procedure: 1. Inspect for excessive noise and vibration. 2. Inspect for external damage, arcing, and loose connections. 3. Notify field maintenance of defects. 4. Close left-side door.
steps.noGoCondition: Excessive noise and/or vibration. Signs of damage, arcing, or loose connections.

zones.name: After Operation
zones.description: After operation (allow 60 min to cool): fuel fill and tank, output connections, oil, fuel drain, batteries, coolant, grates, radiator

steps.procedure: NOTE: Allow generator set to cool for 60 min (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions) before performing After operation PMCS. 1. Clean fuel fill (Figure 1, Item 1) area of dirt and debris (WP 0016, Service Fuel System). 2. Inspect the auxiliary fuel connections for damaged, corroded, or missing parts. 3. Remove fuel fill (Figure 1, Item 1) cap. 4. Inspect cap and strainer for dirt, wear, and defects. 5. Inspect chain and gasket for wear. 6. Replace fuel fill (Figure 1, Item 1) cap. 7. Inspect grounding stud (fuel fill static ground) for damage or corrosion. 8. Notify field maintenance of defect.
steps.noGoCondition: Damaged, corroded, or missing parts. Damaged or missing cap. Punctured or missing strainer. Damaged or missing gasket. Fuel fill cap will not seal. Grounding stud (fuel fill static ground) missing or corroded.

steps.procedure: 1. Refill fuel tank (Figure 1, Item 6) to capacity (WP 0016, Service Fuel System). 2. Notify field maintenance of defect.

1. Inspect ground and load cable connections for tightness to output load board by pulling gently. 2. Tighten as required (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions). 3. Inspect terminals and terminal nuts for indications of arcing or high temperature. 4. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Terminal board shows evidence of arcing or high temperature

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect output terminal board protective cover for indications of arcing or high temperature. 2. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Output terminal board protective cover missing, cracked through, or melted. Missing or damaged hinge or hinge fasteners.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect oil drain outlet (Figure 2, Item 4) for leaks. 2. Notify field maintenance of Class I, II, or III leaks. 3. Notify field maintenance of missing, loose, or cracked oil drain outlet (Figure 2, Item 4) cap.
steps.noGoCondition: Class III leak.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect for leaks. 2. Inspect fuel lines for fraying due to vibration from generator set. 3. Notify field maintenance of any Class I, II, or III oil or coolant leaks.
steps.noGoCondition: Any classification of fuel leak. Class III oil or coolant leaks.

steps.procedure: 1. Check oil level (WP 0017, Service Engine Oil). 2. Add oil as required (WP 0017, Service Engine Oil). 3. Ensure oil fill cap is tightened securely. 4. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Oil fill cap missing.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect fuel drain for leaks, missing cap, or damage. 2. Ensure fuel fill (Figure 1, Item 1) cap is tightened securely. 3. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Any fuel leak. Missing cap.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect batteries (Figure 4, Item 5) for cracked or swollen casings or corroded terminals. 2. Notify field maintenance of corroded terminals.
steps.noGoCondition: Cracked or swollen casing.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect battery cables for corrosion or loose connections. 2. Notify field maintenance of corroded or loose connections.
1. Inspect for leaks. 2. Notify field maintenance of any Class I, II, or III oil or coolant leaks.
steps.noGoCondition: Any classification of fuel leak. Class III oil or coolant leaks.

steps.procedure: 1. Inspect for leaks, cracks, loose hoses, or missing cap. 2. Connect loose hoses. 3. Check coolant level (WP 0015, Service Cooling System). 4. Fill cooling system as required (WP 0015, Service Cooling System). 5. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Class III coolant leak. Missing cap. Hose cannot be reconnected.

steps.procedure: 1. Clean debris from all intake and exhaust grates. 2. Notify field maintenance of defects.

1. Energize DCS (Figure 1, Item 2) and examine coolant temperature indicator (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions). 2. Do not proceed to step 3 unless coolant temperature is below 100°F (38°C). WARNING: Do not open radiator cap unless coolant temperature is below 100°F (37.8°C). 3. Remove radiator cap. 4. Inspect coolant color for contamination. 5. Inspect coolant level and add as required (WP 0015, Service Cooling System). 6. Replace radiator cap and tighten securely. 7. Notify field maintenance of defects.
steps.noGoCondition: Milky or dirty color. Radiator cap missing or cannot be tightened.
